Understanding Async Iterators

Async iterators provide values over time while preserving a familiar iteration protocol.

for await (const value of stream) { consume(value) }

The loop waits for each promise and stops when the iterator reports completion.

Consumers should still handle cancellation so upstream resources can be released promptly.

Backpressure prevents a fast producer from overwhelming a slower consumer.
